title: Datenaufbewahrung
subtitle: How long each dataset is kept, and when its records stop costing local disk.
keepHint: A record is deleted this many days after it happened, wherever it is stored by then.
coldHint: Older records move to object storage and stay queryable. 0 keeps everything on local disk.
coldUnavailable: Set up cold storage below to move older records off local disk.
coldBeforeDelete: Records have to move before they are deleted: use fewer days than the lifetime, or 0.
tieredNote: This dataset moves records to cold storage. Going back to local-only needs the table rebuilt, so it cannot be turned off here.

toast.noPermission: You do not have permission to change retention

coldStorage.title: Cold storage
coldStorage.hint: An object store the event store treats as a second, slower disk. Older records move there and are still queried from the same place — it is not an archive and nothing has to be restored.
coldStorage.writtenNotReady: The bucket is configured but the store has not picked it up. Check that the deployment shares the store's configuration directory.
coldStorage.bucketLocked: The credentials can be changed at any time. The bucket cannot, once records live in it: the parts already moved carry it.
coldStorage.useRole: IAM-Rolle des Servers statt Schlüsseln verwenden
coldStorage.s3Hint: Funktioniert mit AWS S3 und jedem S3-kompatiblen Speicher: MinIO, Ceph, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2 oder Google Cloud Storage (Endpoint https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/ mit HMAC-Schlüsseln).
coldStorage.localHint: Datensätze wandern in den Ordner, der im Event-Store unter /mnt/utmstack-cold eingebunden ist: ein normales Verzeichnis im Datenordner oder eine NFS-Freigabe, die vor dem Start des Stacks auf dem Host über <Datenverzeichnis>/clickhouse/cold gemountet wird. Keine Zugangsdaten nötig.
coldStorage.changeWarning: Records already moved to the current destination are not migrated. They stay there and stop being readable from here until the old destination is copied across by hand.

forbidden.title: Diese Seite gehört der Plattform
forbidden.body: Die Aufbewahrung gilt für die Tabellen, die sich alle Mandanten teilen — nur ein Plattform-Administrator kann sie lesen oder ändern.
